description: This file defines an abstract Java class 'AbstractVersionedInsertRepository' that manages batch insert and update operations with version control, utilizing JDBC templates and prepared statements. It is part of the data access layer in the Thingsboard project.

classes.name: AbstractVersionedInsertRepository
classes.description: An abstract class providing batch insert/update with versioning support for entities, using JDBC.

classes.name: SequencePreparedStatementCreator
classes.description: A record implementing PreparedStatementCreator and SqlProvider to create prepared statements with specific SQL and version column.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Performs batch save or update operations on a list of entities, managing version numbers and insert/update logic.

methods.name: onBatchUpdate
methods.description: Executes batch update SQL statements for entities.

methods.name: onInsertOrUpdate
methods.description: Executes batch insert or update SQL statements for entities.

methods.name: setOnBatchUpdateValues
methods.description: Abstract method to set PreparedStatement values for batch update.

methods.name: setOnInsertOrUpdateValues
methods.description: Abstract method to set PreparedStatement values for insert or update.

methods.name: getBatchUpdateQuery
methods.description: Abstract method to provide SQL query for batch update.

methods.name: getInsertOrUpdateQuery
methods.description: Abstract method to provide SQL query for insert or update.
